note: Flux-integrated differential cross section for charged-current electron-neutrino (nu_e CC) interactions with zero final-state pions (0pi, any number of protons) on argon, in 4 kinematic variables: electron energy E_e, electron angle cos(theta_e) w.r.t. beam, leading proton kinetic energy KE_p, and leading proton angle cos(theta_p) w.r.t. beam. Beam: BNB (Booster Neutrino Beam) intrinsic nu_e component, 6.86e20 POT, 2016-2018 data. Detector: MicroBooNE LArTPC. Target: per nucleon (argon) — paper explicitly divides by N_target = 4.3912e31 nucleons (main.tex ~line 192) and labels units 'cm2/GeV/nucleon' or 'cm2/nucleon' in Supplemental Material tables.
